Let me now plan the feature:

**New feature: substation power budget**

Requirements from the prompt:
1. Sections can be bound to a substation （变电所）. When the object first enters the flow, a section may bind one substation.
2. Trains declare non-negative integer kilowatts per occupancy. Intervals remain UTC half-open.
3. Substation has positive integer power cap, version starting from 1.
4. Merge all published + candidate occupancy start/end into constant segments; accumulate power per segment. Same train's different occupancies counted separately.
5. If input or business conditions fail: any time slice exceeding limit → 422, with time slice and actual power; whole publish or reschedule writes nothing.
6. Parameter changes carry expectedVersion; lowering cap or changing binding that makes existing plans exceed → 409.
7. Unbound legacy sections keep original mode; before binding, must cancel their old occupancies （绑定前须取消其旧占用 — i.e., a section with published occupancies cannot be bound? "绑定前须取消其旧占用" — before binding, its old occupancies must be cancelled).
8. Reschedule validation uses power set after removing old plan and adding full new plan; own old occupancies not double counted.
9. Publish, binding change, and cancel are jointly adjudicated （共同裁决）, freeze binding/power/cap version at the time; history doesn't drift. Sum uses exact integer arithmetic in checkable range.
10. New write retries: new write requests carry non-empty operator and global requestId; structured comparison of operation, resource, all params and expected version; fields no collision. Decimal same value same param, text as-is; replay first full response, changed params 409, failure doesn't occupy key, business and dedup atomically committed, contention doesn't expose unique key errors.
11. Synthesis: two different sections each 60kW, substation cap 100, publishing second at same time rejected; first ends 10:10, second starts 10:10 allowed.

Design decisions:

static List<PowerSlice> mergeSlices(List<Interval> intervals) {
    TreeSet<Instant> points = new TreeSet<>();
    intervals.forEach(i -> { points.add(i.start()); points.add(i.end()); });
    List<PowerSlice> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Instant prev = null;
    for (Instant p : points) {
        if (prev != null && prev.isBefore(p)) {
            long total = 0;
            for (Interval i : intervals)
                if (!i.start().isAfter(prev) && !i.end().isBefore(p)) total += i.powerKw();
            // i.start <= prev && i.end >= p  → covers [prev,p)
            if (total > 0) result.add(new PowerSlice(prev, p, total));
        }
        prev = p;
    }
    return result;
}

private <T> T idempotent(String requestId, String hash, Class<T> type, Supplier<T> action) {
    Optional<T> replay = replay(requestId, hash, type);
    if (replay.isPresent()) return replay.get();
    try {
        return tx.execute(status -> {
            T response = action.get();
            powerRepo.insertRequestRecord(requestId, hash, toJson(response), System.currentTimeMillis());
            return response;

            .orElseThrow(() -> conflict("SUBSTATION_EXISTS", "资源已存在或 requestId 冲突"));

}

}
